name: intraday_range_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the session high and low become self-reinforcing order magnets: systematic TWAP/VWAP algorithms, stop-limit clusters, and delta-hedging desks concentrate resting orders at these levels throughout the day. When NIFTY touches its session extreme and the 5-second bar forms a rejection candle (close in the upper 65% of bar range at session low, lower 65% at session high), it signals that the algorithmic buy or sell wall has absorbed the directional flow. Within 30-90 seconds, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms aggressively fade the extreme because their fill price relative to benchmark has become highly attractive, driving a 12-25 spot point reversion toward the session midpoint.
core_signal_oneliner: Rejection pin bar at session high or low with meaningful intraday range and moderate VIX regime
